Ellen M. (Finance): Heads-up 9999999999 - InvoiceNest and ClearRun remain after initial demos. CFO asked for a one-page recommendation + negotiation asks by Tue noon. Can procurement lead?
Josh P. (Procurement): I got it. I'll pull list and negotiated numbers. Need clarity on pilot credits, onboarding credits, min commit, and early termination fees.
Rae C. (EngOps): EngOps asks: what connectors are native (Snowflake/S3/Kafka), webhook concurrency, bulk export speed, and whether historical reprocesses bill as new units.
Lydia (InvoiceNest Sales): InvoiceNest can do Snowflake native ingest, SFTP, and webhooks. Bulk export >50GB is supported via presigned S3 export. Historical reprocesses are free for pilot; in production, reprocesses are charged unless we agree otherwise.
Priest (Security): Security wants SOC2 Type II, subprocessor list, tenant-level encryption, and whether they support customer-managed keys (CMK/HSM). Also ask for data deletion certification post-termination.
Ellen M. (Finance): addition: include amortized migration ($ estimate), cost sensitivity (20% volume up/down), and ops fallback (manual processing cost per 1k invoices).
Josh P. (Procurement): good. Quick question: does InvoiceNest require a minimum commit? Lydia:
Lydia (InvoiceNest Sales): For enterprise plans we typically ask for a 6-month onboarding minimum for professional services, but pricing can be usage-only with no commit if you prefer. Pilot credit available up to $7k.
Rae C. (EngOps): ClearRun had better parser accuracy on our demo, but they require direct DB read for ingest. That might be a blocker. Anyone confirm their onboarding time?
vendor-bot: "ClearRun: connector team estimates 2w effort for event ingestion; SOC2 in progress; sample dataset available after NDA."
Josh P. (Procurement): if ClearRun needs DB read, legal will flag it. We should ask for an event-based alternative.
Priest (Security): DB read is a hard no unless it's read-only via a narrow service account and approved by infra. Also need proof-of-capability for key separation.
Lydia (InvoiceNest Sales): happy to provide a CMK option and SOC2 report. For sample accuracy test, we can run 500 invoices and return a short accuracy report in 48h after NDA.
Ellen M. (Finance): perfect. Negotiation anchors I want listed in memo: 1) Pilot credit >= $5k, 2) onboarding/professional services credit to offset migration, 3) waive reprocess fees for first 6 months, 4) include 120-180d retention in base, 5) SLA credits for parser regressions.
Rae C. (EngOps): add an explicit connector SLA: time-to-deliver snowflake connector within X days or PS hours included. Also ask for a rate-limit burst allowance during backfills.
Josh P. (Procurement): will include. Also asking vendors for a sample rate card with: list prices, committed tiers, overage pricing, egress/export costs, and termination fees.
vendor-bot: "InvoiceNest: rate card link sent to procurement@redwood.com; ClearRun: pricing deck available upon request."
Priest (Security): also ask for subprocessor list and whether any subprocessors are in regions with additional data residency requirements.
Ellen M. (Finance): timeline: Josh fill pricing rows by EOD tomorrow; Rae fill integration delta (eng-weeks) and reprocess policy; Priest review risk items and return redlines. I will assemble memo Mon morning and share for quick review.
Lydia (InvoiceNest Sales): if it helps, we can offer a pilot-to-contract credit of up to $10k if you commit to a 12mo contract within 45 days of pilot end.
Josh P. (Procurement): thanks Lydia. We'll use that as a negotiation anchor. One more: can vendors provide a sample invoice set w/ anonymized PII removed so product can run the accuracy test without an NDA?
Lydia (InvoiceNest Sales): we can anonymize and share a 200-invoice sample without NDA. For full 500-sample accuracy runs we need signed NDA.
Rae C. (EngOps): that'll speed things up. Also request a short config snippet for Snowflake ingest (example): ```
COPY INTO invoices FROM 's3://invoicenest-exports/...'
CREDENTIALS = (aws_key_id='***' aws_secret_key='***')
FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE=CSV FIELD_DELIMITER=',');
```
Josh P. (Procurement): great. I'll collect inputs and post the draft scorecard here. If vendors push hard on minimums, procurement will push back and ask for PS credits.
Ellen M. (Finance): thanks team 99999 - will expect draft by EOD tomorrow then finalize for execs Tue noon.
